3. **Applicable Propositions**: Specifically, Prop 7 and Prop 13 are relevant when considering Iris's testimonies about the fight between Mystic Maya and Mystic Elise. According to Testimony 2, Mystic Elise had her back to the stone lantern, which implies that Mystic Maya was in front of the lantern and thus in the direct line of sight of Mystic Elise if she were facing her (Prop 13).
